name: pll_afc_off_code16_ctrl600_ref10000_4p_6500n_v1
interpretation: Direct physical fine-loop capture from fixed code16. No AFC Done/Fail/success is manufactured. No lock in this window means only not captured within the measured6.5us.
comparison_differences: AFC-on drives CODE using MOS outputs; this control uses the five original ideal DC voltage sources.
AFC-on adds AFC logic, two-node MOS clamp, clamp reference and CP enable gates; this control retains the guarded original fine-loop topology.
AFC-on physically holds both LPF nodes near half-supply before handoff; this control only specifies the same nominal initial IC. Actual enable-time LPF voltages must be measured.
This control consumes no AFC supply power. Power is a bounded whole-PLL observation, not an exact matched loading or FoM improvement claim.
scope: TT1.2V25C, pre-layout, no stochastic noise; numerical maximum step and saved strobe require appropriate convergence checks.
